captions: To a stranger you bumped into.
To your boss. For being late.
To a friend. For a message you forgot.
But your sins with Him? Still waiting.
You think He's tired of hearing from you.
Tonight, you walk out under the stars.

verses.text: “Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant.”

hook.text: You said sorry 6 times today. Not once to Allah.
